About the role

Fixture Robotics builds autonomous mobile manipulators for warehouses and labs. We are looking for a Senior Robotics Software Engineer to own core pieces of our motion planning and robot control stack.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in robotics
  • Strong C++17 and Python
  • Experience with ROS / ROS 2
  • Comfort debugging on real hardware

Responsibilities

  • Design and ship real-time C++ and Python software running on the robot fleet
  • Build motion planning, state estimation and perception integration in ROS 2
  • Improve simulation and hardware-in-the-loop testing infrastructure

About Fixture Robotics

Fixture Robotics makes mobile manipulators that automate repetitive material handling in warehouses and research labs.
